summary: Populate resourceIDFieldOverrides with PodScan's {resource}_id fields so sync stores rows. Also bind mentions typed-table values in column order.
reason: PodScan items carry alert_id, category_id, episode_id and podcast_id rather than id, and export listings are keyed by path. With both override maps empty every item fell through the generic fallback list and was dropped (issue #383: categories consumed 163, stored 0).
validated_outcome: UpsertBatch stores categories, alerts, episodes, podcasts, mentions and export listings keyed by their spec ID fields; go build, go vet and go test pass.
